_about: Things that can happen to the player while time jumps forward. chance is per 100 days; focus multiplies the chance for that focus (2 = twice as likely). worseWhenUnwell makes it likelier when health is low. once: only ever happens once. remember: it goes in the life journal. kind 'death' lists the ways a life can end (picked when a life ends; how likely that is depends on age and health).

events.text: A bad fever kept you in bed for a week.
You fell from a tree and broke your arm. The cast itched for weeks.
You found 5 {currency} in the gutter. Finders keepers.
You said your first word. Everyone argued about what it was.
You took your first steps, then sat down hard and looked very surprised.
You won a prize at school. It's still on the shelf at home.
A falling-out with a friend left you sore for a long time.
Someone talked you out of 20 {currency} with a promise that never came true.
An old debt was paid back, with interest, out of nowhere.
You fell seriously ill. Recovery was slow.
You were hurt in an accident on the road. It could have been much worse.
A sudden accident ended your life far too soon.
An illness you couldn't shake took you in the end.
You went to sleep one night and didn't wake up. It was peaceful.
Your heart gave out one ordinary afternoon.
